additional_info.subject: ID0436126-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002560]  Charger Issue CRM:02888000130
additional_info.body:
Hi Giuseppe, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
Regarding the OCPP connection, it's back online. Regarding the Outlet being unavailable, there is a hotfix for this particular issue where we are having a communication timeout.
This hotfix mitigates the error completely unless there is really a hardware issue.
If I have your permission, I can install the hotfix when no one is charging and it will take around 5-10mins to install, you will see the outlets unavailable in the backend.
Please provide me your feedback.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
